Standard: Air vehicles with bailout capability have a clear bailout path. Jettisonable components and other debris do not impact the air vehicle or create a collision potential with other personnel bailing out of the air vehicle. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of engineering drawings, digital models, or the physical air vehicle configuration verifies bailout exit clearance dimensions. Demonstration.
  (1) Verify by ground demonstration that the intended anthropometric population of bailout parachute users can effectively clear the bailout exit.
